originating_goal: Priority number one: fix the heartbeat by making the one-host sovereign ephemeral-console fallback actually run both separated v12 processes required by the activation verifier.
claim_expiration_or_release_condition: SATISFIED: separated ephemeral carrier+worker repair merged and validation evidence recorded.
collision_boundaries: did not acquire, alter, release, or replace G18 claim/fence/lease
did not mutate control/heartbeat-state.json, live carrier state, node-local activation receipts, or worker registry runtime state
did not change TV/TVC credential or route authority
did not use GitHub tokens or NON-TV/TVC secrets/tokens as production authority
did not use Render/Vercel/Cloudflare/GitHub Actions as sovereign runtime authority
did not create a second canonical heartbeat

defect_evidence.verifier_requirement: continuous_runtime_live requires worker-runtime-state.json and worker_coordination_checkpoint_observed requires worker runtime output
defect_evidence.finding: The one-host fallback could start only the carrier while the v12 verifier requires both carrier and worker coordinator. A newly materialized ephemeral node therefore could not satisfy all nine activation predicates through this fallback.

implemented_result: ephemeral start launches and records both carrier and worker coordinator processes
restart replaces and proves replacement of both processes
service receipt identifies separated v12 carrier and worker runtime
regression tests prove worker-runtime command/pid/state and secret/token scrubbing
validation workflow uses anonymous checkout and no GitHub credential token
next_task_after_release: Existing G18 machine owner consumes the repaired one-host fallback and produces the nine-predicate node-local activation proof. Under v12, legacy control/heartbeat-state.json remains immutable at HB29; success is a new control/heartbeat-carrier-runtime-state.json advancing from HB30 onward plus the nine-predicate proof.
